protocol.scope: Only reused original Atlas 24 tasks; no corpus_v2 queries inspected or measured.
protocol.queries: Identical original task prompt text in every profile and repeat.
protocol.sessions: Fresh empty task session per observation; no stored memory or model requests.
protocol.order: Profile order rotates by task and reverses on even repeats.
protocol.timing: Session creation plus synchronous retrieval; excludes initial indexing and MCP/model startup.
protocol.cpu: Current Python process CPU only; child process CPU and resident memory are not measured.
protocol.host_conditions: Concurrent development activity and shared warm OS/SQLite caches; timings are descriptive.
protocol.primary_ground_truth: Independent Python AST or narrow immutable TypeScript fixture grammar; exact complete source lines required.
protocol.helpers: Local tokens helper called by search only; language/runtime/library dependencies are outside scope.
protocol.integration_callers: Seven explicit DocumentService entry points per language, separately judged from direct helpers.
protocol.budget: Engine UTF-8 byte planning estimate, not billed model usage. Adapter removes metadata after rich-engine budget packing.
protocol.freshness: Independent disk SHA-256 comparisons before/after edit and deletion; exact stale path sets required.
